meaning.en: Paippalada asked Brahma
meaning.hi: पैप्पलाद ने ब्रह्मा से पूछा

words.sanskrit: brahma-vishnu-rudranam madhye ko va adhikataro dhyeyah syat

meaning.en: among Brahma, Vishnu, and Rudra, who is more deserving of meditation
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा-विष्णु-रुद्र में कौन अधिक ध्येय है

words.sanskrit: bahuni punyani kritani yena tenaiva labhyah parameshvaro'sau

meaning.en: only one who has done many good deeds attains the Supreme Lord
meaning.hi: जिसने बहुत पुण्य किए वही परमेश्वर को पाता है

meaning.en: whose offspring I am, yet Hari and the chief gods, deluded, do not know him
meaning.hi: जिनका अंशज मैं हूँ, हरि और इन्द्र भी मोहवश नहीं जानते

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the Lord worthy of choice, the father, Maheshwara
meaning.hi: वरेण्य प्रभु, पिता, महेश

meaning.en: who brings Brahma into being
meaning.hi: जो ब्रह्मा को उत्पन्न करते हैं

meaning.en: who sends forth all the Vedas, the foremost
meaning.hi: जो समस्त वेदों को भेजते हैं

meaning.en: that Lord, the father of all deities
meaning.hi: वे देवताओं के पिता प्रभु

meaning.en: the father of both me and Vishnu, the adorable one
meaning.hi: मेरे और विष्णु दोनों के जनक, आराध्य

meaning.en: who at the final hour gathers in every world
meaning.hi: जो अंतकाल में सब लोकों को समेट लेते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa ekah shreshthashcha sarvashasta sa eva varishthashcha

meaning.en: he alone is the greatest, the teacher of all, the most exalted
meaning.hi: वही श्रेष्ठ, सर्वशास्ता, वरिष्ठ हैं

words.sanskrit: yo ghoram vesham asthaya sharabhakhyam maheshvarah

meaning.en: who, taking the terrifying form called Sharabha, Maheshwara
meaning.hi: जो शरभ नामक भयानक रूप धारण कर

meaning.en: subdued the man-lion who had become the destroyer of worlds, mighty as he was
meaning.hi: लोकसंहारक नृसिंह को महाबली ने वश में किया

meaning.en: as Hari fled, the lords of the gods followed after
meaning.hi: हरि के भागने पर देवेश्वर पीछे दौड़े

words.sanskrit: ma vadhih purusham vishnum vikramasva mahan asi

meaning.en: do not kill the person Vishnu, be gracious, for you are the greater one
meaning.hi: विष्णु को मत मारो, कृपालु बनो, आप महान हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: kripaya bhagavan vishnum vidadara nakhaih kharaih

meaning.en: with compassion, the Lord tore Vishnu with his sharp claws
meaning.hi: कृपापूर्वक भगवान ने विष्णु को तीक्ष्ण नखों से चीरा

meaning.en: clad in hide, that great hero became known as Virabhadra
meaning.hi: चर्मवस्त्र धारी महावीर वीरभद्र बने

words.sanskrit: sa eko rudro dhyeyah sarveshaam sarvasiddhaye

meaning.en: he alone is the Rudra deserving meditation for every accomplishment
meaning.hi: वही रुद्र सबकी सिद्धि के लिए ध्येय हैं

words.sanskrit: yo brahmanah panchavakrahanta tasmai rudraya namo astu

meaning.en: who destroyed one of Brahma's five faces; honor to that Rudra
meaning.hi: जिन्होंने ब्रह्मा का एक मुख नष्ट किया, उस रुद्र को नमन

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: who with a spark from his forehead reduces the world to ash
meaning.hi: जो ललाट की चिंगारी से जगत को भस्म कर देते हैं

meaning.en: then recreating, protects and reveals it again on his own terms
meaning.hi: फिर रचकर स्वतंत्र रूप से रक्षा कर प्रकट करते हैं

meaning.en: who with the left foot struck down terrifying Time
meaning.hi: जिन्होंने बाएँ पैर से भयानक काल को मारा

meaning.en: and drank the burning poison Halahala
meaning.hi: और जलते हलाहल को पिया

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: pleased by Vishnu who worshipped with his eyes at the left foot, he gave the discus
meaning.hi: बाएँ चरण को नेत्रों से पूजे जाने पर प्रसन्न होकर चक्र दिया

words.sanskrit: yo dakshayajne surasanghan vijitya vishnum babandhoragapashena virah

meaning.en: who in Daksha's sacrifice, defeating the gods, bound Vishnu with a serpent noose
meaning.hi: दक्षयज्ञ में देवताओं को जीतकर विष्णु को नागपाश से बाँधा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: who, merely in play, burned Tripura
meaning.hi: जिन्होंने लीलामात्र से त्रिपुर भस्म किया

meaning.en: having sun, moon, and fire as eyes, bewildering even wise Vishnu
meaning.hi: सोम-सूर्य-अग्नि नेत्रधारी ने विष्णु को भी मोहित किया

words.sanskrit: sarve devah pashutam avapuh svayam tasmat pashupatir babhuva

meaning.en: all the gods came to seem like creatures by comparison, and he became Pashupati
meaning.hi: सब देवता पशुतुल्य लगे, वे पशुपति बने

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yo matsyakurmadivarahasimhan vishnum kramantam vamanam adivishnum

meaning.en: who bewildered Vishnu in the forms of fish, tortoise, boar, lion, and dwarf
meaning.hi: मत्स्य-कूर्म-वराह-सिंह-वामन रूपी विष्णु को मोहित किया

words.sanskrit: viviklavam pidyamanam sureshamhbasmichakara manmatham yamam cha

meaning.en: seeing troubled Indra, burned Kamadeva and Yama to ash
meaning.hi: व्याकुल इन्द्र को देखकर काम और यम को भस्म किया

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: evam prakarena bahudha pratushtva kshamapayamasur nilakantham maheshvaram

meaning.en: having praised him in many ways, they sought forgiveness from blue-throated Maheshwara
meaning.hi: अनेक प्रकार से स्तुति कर नीलकंठ से क्षमा माँगी

meaning.en: the suffering born of the three afflictions -- birth, death, old age, and the rest
meaning.hi: तापत्रय से उत्पन्न जन्म-मृत्यु-जरा आदि

meaning.en: the Supreme Lord took away every kind of such suffering
meaning.hi: परमेश्वर ने सभी दुख हर लिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: evam mantraih prarthyamana atma vai sarvadehinam

meaning.en: when sought with mantras, being the very self of all embodied beings
meaning.hi: मंत्रों से प्रार्थित, सभी देहधारियों की आत्मा

words.sanskrit: shankaro bhagavan adyo rarakhsha sakalah prajah

meaning.en: Lord Shankara, the primal one, protected all creation
meaning.hi: भगवान शंकर आद्य ने सारी प्रजा की रक्षा की

meaning.en: whose pair of lotus feet is sought even by Vishnu
meaning.hi: जिनके चरणकमल विष्णु द्वारा भी खोजे जाते हैं

meaning.en: having praised the praiseworthy Maheshana, beyond speech and mind
meaning.hi: वाणी-मन से परे स्तुत्य महेशान की स्तुति कर

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: bhaktya namratanoh vishnoh prasadam akarod vibhuh

meaning.en: the all-pervading Lord, his body bowed in devotion, granted grace to Vishnu
meaning.hi: भक्तिपूर्वक झुके विष्णु को विभु ने प्रसाद दिया

words.sanskrit: yato vacho nivartante aprapya manasa saha

meaning.en: from which words turn back, unable to reach, along with the mind
meaning.hi: जहाँ से वाणी मन सहित लौट आती है

words.sanskrit: anandam brahmano vidvan na bibheti kadachaneti

meaning.en: the one who knows the bliss of Brahman never fears again
meaning.hi: जो ब्रह्मानंद जानता है वह कभी भयभीत नहीं होता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: anoraniyan mahato mahiyan atma'sya jantorbihito guhayam

meaning.en: subtler than the subtlest, greater than the greatest, the self hidden in the cave of the heart
meaning.hi: अणु से सूक्ष्म, महत् से महान, हृदयगुहा में स्थित आत्मा

words.sanskrit: tam akratum pashyati vitashoko dhatuh prasadan mahimanam isham

meaning.en: the one free of desire and sorrow sees this greatness of the Lord through grace
meaning.hi: अक्रतु वीतशोक कृपा से महिमा देखता है

meaning.en: held in the hearts of Vasishtha, Vyasa's son, Vamadeva, and Brahma as foremost
meaning.hi: वसिष्ठ-व्यासपुत्र-वामदेव-विरिंचि के हृदय में भावित

meaning.en: praised by Sanatsujata and the other eternal sages, this great Lord, the adorable primal deity
meaning.hi: सनत्सुजातादि सनातन ऋषियों से वंदित आदिदेव

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: satyo nityah sarvasakshi maheshah nityanando nirvikalpo nirakhyah

meaning.en: Maheshwara is truth, eternal, witness of all, ever blissful, beyond alternatives, beyond name
meaning.hi: महेश सत्य, नित्य, सर्वसाक्षी, नित्यानंद, निर्विकल्प, निराख्य हैं

meaning.en: possessing inconceivable power, the Lord of the mountain, shaping this world through his own creative power
meaning.hi: अचिंत्यशक्ति गिरीश ने स्वविद्या से जगत रचा

meaning.en: this deeply bewildering illusion belongs to both Vishnu and me, O one of good vows
meaning.hi: यह मोहकारी माया विष्णु और मेरी दोनों की है, हे सुव्रत

meaning.en: through meditation on his lotus feet, even the impossibly difficult becomes easily crossed
meaning.hi: उनके पादपद्म के ध्यान से दुस्तर भी सुतर हो जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Vishnu, the womb of the universe, together with his own emanations
meaning.hi: विष्णु, विश्वजगत् की योनि, अपने अंशों सहित

meaning.en: having taken form as a portion born from me, sustains the entire world
meaning.hi: मेरे अंश से उत्पन्न होकर सम्पूर्ण जगत का पालन करते हैं

words.sanskrit: vinasham kalato yati tato'nyat sakalam mrisha

meaning.en: everything else passes into destruction through time and is therefore unreal
meaning.hi: बाकी सब काल से नष्ट होकर मिथ्या है

words.sanskrit: om tasmai mahagrasaya mahadevaya shuline maheshvaraya mridaya tasmai rudraya namo astu

meaning.en: Om, honor to that great devourer, great god, wielder of the trident, Maheshwara, the gentle one, Rudra
meaning.hi: ॐ महाग्रास, महादेव, शूलिन्, महेश्वर, मृड, रुद्र को नमस्कार

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the one Vishnu, a great being, existing scattered in countless individual forms
meaning.hi: एक विष्णु अनेक रूपों में पृथक् विद्यमान

words.sanskrit: trimllokan vyapya bhutatma bhunkte vishvabhuk avyayah

meaning.en: pervading the three worlds as the soul of beings, the imperishable one enjoys the universe
meaning.hi: त्रिलोक व्याप्त भूतात्मा अव्यय विश्व का भोग करते हैं

words.sanskrit: chaturbhishcha chaturbhishcha dvabhyam panchamireva cha huyate cha punardvabhyam

meaning.en: through four, four, two, and five, offerings are made, and again through two
meaning.hi: चार-चार, दो, पाँच से, फिर दो से हवन होता है

meaning.en: may that Vishnu of mine be pleased
meaning.hi: मेरे वे विष्णु प्रसन्न हों

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the offering is Brahman, the oblation is Brahman, offered by Brahman into the fire that is Brahman
meaning.hi: अर्पण ब्रह्म, हवि ब्रह्म, ब्रह्माग्नि में ब्रह्म द्वारा हुत

meaning.en: through steady absorption in Brahman-action, one is meant to reach Brahman alone
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधि से ब्रह्म ही प्राप्त होना है

words.sanskrit: shara jivastadangeshu bhati nityam harih svayam

meaning.en: beings are like arrows in whose limbs Hari himself eternally shines
meaning.hi: जीव शर हैं, जिनके अंगों में हरि स्वयं चमकते हैं

meaning.en: this Sharabha is Brahman directly, the bestower of liberation, O great sage
meaning.hi: यह शरभ साक्षात् ब्रह्म, मोक्षदाता है, हे महामुने

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: purely by the power of illusion, the gods become confused by possessiveness and the like
meaning.hi: माया के वश से देवता ममता आदि से मोहित होते हैं

meaning.en: no one is capable of speaking even a small fraction of his greatness
meaning.hi: उनकी महिमा का अंश भी कोई नहीं कह सकता

words.sanskrit: parat parataram brahma yat parat parato harih

meaning.en: Brahman higher than the highest, Hari higher than that even
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म परात्पर, हरि उससे भी परात्पर

words.sanskrit: parat paratharo hi ishah tasmat tulyo'dhiko na hi

meaning.en: the Lord is higher still, beyond that; nothing is his equal or superior
meaning.hi: ईश उससे भी परात्पर, उनके तुल्य-अधिक कोई नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Shiva alone is eternal; everything else is unreal
meaning.hi: शिव अकेले नित्य, शेष सब मिथ्या

words.sanskrit: tasmat sarvan parityajya dhyeyan vishnvadikan suran

meaning.en: therefore, setting aside every other object of meditation including Vishnu and the gods
meaning.hi: इसलिए विष्णु आदि देवों को छोड़कर

meaning.en: Shiva alone should always be meditated on, the liberator from all worldly existence
meaning.hi: शिव ही सदा ध्येय, सर्वसंसारमोचक

meaning.en: to that great devourer, Maheshwara, honor
meaning.hi: उस महाग्रास महेश्वर को नमस्कार

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: paippaladam mahashastram na deyam yasya kasyachit

meaning.en: this great Paippalada scripture should not be given to just anyone
meaning.hi: यह पैप्पलाद महाशास्त्र किसी को भी नहीं देना चाहिए

meaning.en: not to the faithless, the ungrateful, the ill-conducted, the wicked at heart
meaning.hi: नास्तिक, कृतघ्न, दुर्वृत्त, दुरात्मा को नहीं

meaning.en: not to the hypocritical, the cruel, the deceitful, the liar
meaning.hi: दंभी, निर्दयी, शठ, असत्यभाषी को नहीं

meaning.en: but to one of good vows, sincere devotion, good conduct, gentle nature
meaning.hi: सुव्रत, सुभक्त, सुवृत्त, सुशील को

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: to one devoted to the teacher, self-controlled, peaceful, honest of mind
meaning.hi: गुरुभक्त, दांत, शांत, ऋजुचित्त को

meaning.en: it should be given to a Shiva-devotee steady in Brahman-centered action
meaning.hi: शिवभक्त, ब्रह्मकर्म में स्थिर बुद्धि को दिया जाए

meaning.en: it should be given only to one's own sincere and grateful follower
meaning.hi: अपने ही कृतज्ञ भक्त को दिया जाए

words.sanskrit: na datavyam sada gopyam yatnenaiva dvijottama

meaning.en: it should always be guarded and never handed out carelessly, O finest of the twice-born
meaning.hi: इसे सदा गोपनीय रखा जाए, हे द्विजोत्तम

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: etat paippaladam mahashastram yo'dhite shravayed dvijah sa janmamaranebhyo mukto bhavati

meaning.en: the twice-born who studies and teaches this great scripture is freed from birth and death
meaning.hi: जो द्विज इसे पढ़े-सुनाए वह जन्म-मृत्यु से मुक्त होता है

words.sanskrit: yo janite so'mritatvam cha gacchati garbhavasadvimukto bhavati

meaning.en: whoever knows it attains immortality, freed from dwelling in the womb
meaning.hi: जो जाने वह अमरत्व पाए, गर्भवास से मुक्त हो

words.sanskrit: surapanat puto bhavati svarnasteyat puto bhavati brahmahatyat puto bhavati gurutalpagamanat puto bhavati

meaning.en: purified even from drinking forbidden substances, stealing gold, harming a teacher's family, and similar faults
meaning.hi: सुरापान, स्वर्णचोरी, गुरुतल्पगमन आदि से पवित्र होता है

words.sanskrit: sa sarvan vedan adhito bhavati sa sarvan devan dhyato bhavati

meaning.en: he becomes knower of all the Vedas, meditator on all the gods
meaning.hi: वह समस्त वेदों का ज्ञाता, सभी देवों का ध्याता होता है

words.sanskrit: na sa punaravartate na sa punaravartate brahmaiva bhavati

meaning.en: he does not return again, he does not return again; he becomes Brahman itself
meaning.hi: वह फिर नहीं लौटता, वह फिर नहीं लौटता, ब्रह्म ही बनता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
